text: I wasted 2 of the 3 screen protectors just trying to apply them on to one Nexus 4. They felt cheap at first but I figured I'd give it a shot anyway. These screen protectors, for whatever reason, seemed to already have dust on them when I tried putting them on. I had already wiped down with a microfiber cloth and wasn't in a dusty room or had carpet. It was kind of difficult to align it but it's possible. Mine ended up being slightly off to the right but I'm only keeping it on until some new ones come in. I can see the potential in it though, if you can align it perfectly and get a good set of protectors. It feels like it's not there after a short while in both touch and look. Overall, I will probably go with another brand.
label: Neutral

text: Have had several Spigen cases over the years, and this one has the same high quality that I've come to expect from the brand. Fit is exact. TPU is firmer and grips phone more tightly than other TPU cases I've had. Appreciate the textured exterior - the S22 Ultra is heavy, and exceedingly slippery when naked. Although this case is still not what I'd call "grippy", it's sufficient for the task. I also appreciate that Spigen had this case available for order before the S22 Ultra launch day. I don't usually jump on the latest tech, but my old phone was on life support, I'd pre-ordered an S22, and needed to switch to the new phone quickly once it was in-hand. Given the obscene cost of the S22 and its almost ungrippable exterior, I didn't dare handle it until it had a proper case. Thanks Spigen and Amazon!
label: Positive

text: OUCH! I have been a LEO for 14 years. I love the ability to have the in ear sound of my radio but not at the cost of me going nuts. First, it looks good, but that is where the positives end. When I connected the earbud to the tube, it went in fine with no issues, but when I tried to put it in my ear....it would not stay! The earbud would not stay in my ear and the tube started hurting my ear. The sad thing is that the tube is from Zeadio. I was really disappointed in this. I was really hoping that it would improve the sound quality, but it did not.
label: Negative

text: I have said it before: I have been using these Scosch magnetic phone mounts for 5 years or so with a variety of iphone models. They are so handy, because the phones just pop onto them and pop off easily when you grab them to go. In the meantime, the magnet holds the phone sturdily. I have had no issue whatsoever with the phone departing its hold by the magnet, even on rocky dirt and gravel roads. Before these I had tried a bunch of clasp-hold devices, but the old claspers were extraordinarily awkward to mount the phone, check the phone and retrieve the phone. These Scosche magnetic holders were the answer to all those issues.
label: Positive

text: I really like the style and price of this lifeproof & purchased it with the thought of it being useful at the beach and pool. It does keep the phone safe from water damage but my speaker has become distorted & my camera has been affected the most, my picture quality has went down tremendously. I can’t use my flash or the picture is just a pink blur (the color from the case interacts with flash). My camera also will not focus now, it moves in and out. I’m disappointed. My phone works well without the case and it’s a hassle to have to take it off for pictures. I wouldn’t recommend you buy this.
label: Neutral

text: And being able to pop off the top and replace it is nice. I only bought it because it was so brightly colored and I love that. The thing I do not love is that the clear, bright pink top is already scratched up and is starting to look tired and I have had it for only about 3 weeks or less. Not impressed with how scratched up and nasty it is already looking. I would have thought that knowing it was going to get scratched up with normal every day wear that they would have worked on a different plastic that didn't scratch as much.

text: The micro-cable charging cord has a "shaky" connection with its respective port and amazingly there is no light indicator displaying the progress of the unit's charge like just about every product of its kind I've had!! There is not even a solid light indicating that's its charging at all a little worrisome considering the semi-loose cord-port connection I described earlier. This is nothing more than a company cost effective stamped out cheaply made product with high margins and low quality. Here's a cliche-"you get what you pay for". The rating on this product was 4.6 when I purchased it and 4.3 when it arrived two days later. I have never been so disappointed with an Amazon product-it's a piece of JUNK!
label: Negative

text: Yes, it's flexible, but it is not easy to install. I also purchased a charging stand for my Ionic and this case makes it too big to fit. It's not unattractive, but it is noticeably bigger and in my opinion, detracts from the sleek design of the watch. The increase in size also prevents correctly entering the locking code. I actually disabled the code rather than fumble around with trying to touch tiny numbers with my fat fingers through this screen. I won't return it because it's not worth the hassle, but I'm ordering the traditional flat screen protectors as a replacement.
label: Negative

text: It has two options to install. Comes with everything you need to install. Easy instructions. I chose the vent option and it doesnt just slide in but has knob adjustment to secure on to air vent. Keeps it secure. The holder for my phone is very secure design. It supports your phone at bottom and then squeezes together on the sides for a secure fit. Then has a release button to remove your phone from holder. Great design and very sturdy. Has a year warranty. Very happy to finally have a way to secure my phone while I'm driving. I've tried them all and this is the best.
label: Positive

text: First of all, the Noise cancellation/battery life/sound quality/earpiece fit are all very good with this earpiece. The problem is I have had this earpiece since Oct. 25 and about 2 months after I bought it it began dropping connectivity with my phone. I could get the earpiece to connect by turning it off and on but connectivity would be dropped on the very next call and every call after that. Called Plantronics customer support and she said I would have to un-pair/re-pair ear piece with phone. That worked for a little while but then it started dropping connectivity again so I have to do the process all over again. Earpiece continues to drop connectivity. Very aggravating that I have to stop phone calls and work to un-pair/re-pair the earpiece.
label: Negative

text: I had previously used this pen for over a year with no issues until I dropped it from my standing desk oneee too many times, which was completely my fault. text: Easy to use per the video - I could have lined up a little better around the home key.....make sure the home button is all in the hole. Put phone in a CoverON Hybrid Armor Cover w/kickstand - then carry it around on my belt in an AGOZ Pouch Case Holster Cover w/magnetic closure.... Awesome setup

text: Only charges to 94% then discharges too quickly with use. NFC also doesn't work with this replacement. This is typical of other user complaints on Amazon who suspect that this is not really an OEM battery. The picture in the ad shows an OEM battery labeled "Made in Korea." But the replacement I received is "Made in China" and the label is slightly inconstant in other areas so maybe this isn't really an OEM battery after all. Amazon did accept it for a refund but they still insist that it's a legitimate OEM battery. Samsung tech support suggested wiping the cache memory but that did not help. Quite simply, the battery does not look or perform like the OEM that came with the phone or that is pictured here.
label: Negative
